name: minus-account-loop
displayName: Minus Account Loop — Antigravity Multi-Account Switcher
description: Switch between unlimited Google accounts in Antigravity IDE or VS Code with zero restarts, zero terminal interruption, and quota-aware auto-rotation via native Windows Credential Manager.

minusAccountLoop.autoRotateImmediately.description: Automatically rotate to the next available account when quota hits 0% without waiting for a manual click.

minusAccountLoop.confirmBeforeSwitch.description: Prompt for confirmation before reloading editor to switch accounts. Set to false for instant 1-click switching.

minusAccountLoop.maxQuickSlots.description: Number of quick-access slot buttons to display in the status bar (0-30). You can save, switch, and auto-rotate an UNLIMITED number of accounts regardless of this setting.

minusAccountLoop.preventDuplicateSession.description: Prevents saving the same active Google account into multiple profile slots.

minusAccountLoop.surgicalPruning.description: Prunes non-credential cache and workspace storage when saving profiles, shrinking profile size from ~500MB to ~3MB.

minusAccountLoop.promptUnsavedChanges.description: Prompt to save dirty or unsaved files before switching accounts to prevent data loss.

minusAccountLoop.userDataDirectory.description: Custom User Data directory (leave empty to auto-detect based on current editor - Antigravity/Code/Cursor/Windsurf)

minusAccountLoop.logPollIntervalMs.description: How often to poll logs for rate limit errors (milliseconds)
